nodes.metadata_json: {"branch":"hw","confidence":50,"prompt":"User discovered that HW server-side date propagation restores dates on dependent issues after deletion. The 'auto' badge (dateSource=computed) only covers client-side CPM virtual dates, not server-propagated ones. Showing 'computed' after user deletes dates is arguably misleading — CPM fills them back in immediately. No backend flag exists to distinguish server-propagated from manually-set dates. Options: (1) suppress computed dates after user clears, (2) debounce computed injection until server round-trip, (3) improve messaging (e.g. 'dates calculated from dependencies'), (4) leave as-is. Parked for discussion with team."}
